        isc.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
        COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('次级', '可疑', '损失') THEN 1

        FROM risk_classification rc2
        WHERE rc2.loan_id = ld.loan_id

    i.institution_name,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS insufficient_provision_loan_balance

    loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN
    provision_snapshot ps ON lbs.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date

    pi.instruction_amount

    payment_instruction pi

    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id

WITH institution_payment_stats AS (
    SELECT
        p.institution_id,
        SUM(p.amount) AS total_instruction_amount
    FROM payment_instruction p
    JOIN loan_drawdown l ON p.loan_id = l.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id

    JOIN industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code

),
all_institution_payment_stats AS (

        p.institution_id,
        SUM(p.amount) AS total_instruction_amount

),
combined_stats AS (
    SELECT

    restricted_amount AS 违规流入金额,
    total_amount AS 指令金额合计,
    CASE
        WHEN total_amount = 0 THEN 0.0
        ELSE restricted_amount * 1.0 / total_amount

    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_id,
    ma.maturity_on,
    wp.actual_termination_on
FROM
    wealth_product wp
JOIN
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id

WITH GuarantorCounts AS (
    SELECT
        g.guarantor_party_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT g.commitment_id) AS guarantee_count
    FROM guarantor_commitment g
    GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id
),

    SELECT
        c.borrower_party_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.agreement_id) AS borrower_count
    FROM credit_agreement c
    GROUP BY c.borrower_party_id
),
MutualParties AS (
    SELECT
        gc.guarantor_party_id
    FROM GuarantorCounts gc
    INNER JOIN BorrowerCounts bc ON gc.guarantor_party_id = bc.borrower_party_id
)

    p.display_name AS party_name,
    gc.guarantee_count,
    bc.borrower_count
FROM MutualParties mp
JOIN party p ON mp.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN GuarantorCounts gc ON mp.guarantor_party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
JOIN BorrowerCounts bc ON mp.guarantor_party_id = bc.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY gc.guarantee_count DESC;

    pe.business_date,
    ptc.name_zh,
    pe.amount,
    ou.unit_name

JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type

    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ind_reg.sector_name_zh AS borrower_industry_name,
    ind_target.sector_name_zh AS target_industry_name,

JOIN
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id

    industry_sector ind_reg ON op.industry_code = ind_reg.sector_code
LEFT JOIN
    industry_sector ind_target ON ca.target_industry_code = ind_target.sector_code

    AND ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL

    ca.contract_amount DESC;

    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    from_holder.party_id AS payer_party_id,
    to_holder.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM
    payment_event pe
JOIN
    account from_acc ON pe.from_account_id = from_acc.account_id
JOIN
    account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN
    account_holder from_holder ON from_acc.account_id = from_holder.account_id
JOIN
    account_holder to_holder ON to_acc.account_id = to_holder.account_id
JOIN
    party_relation pr ON (
        (pr.source_party_id = from_holder.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = to_holder.party_id)
        OR
        (pr.source_party_id = to_holder.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = from_holder.party_id)
    )
WHERE
    pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
    AND pe.status = '已清算'
ORDER BY
    pe.amount DESC;

    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name
HAVING

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(pe.amount) AS total_amount
FROM
    payment_event pe
JOIN
    account acc_from ON pe.from_account_id = acc_from.account_id
JOIN
    institution i ON acc_from.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    pe.is_cash = 1
    AND pe.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
HAVING
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) >= 50
ORDER BY
    total_amount DESC;

    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id

JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE isec.risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类')
GROUP BY sm.staff_id
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT
        i.institution_name,
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.disbursed_amount AS principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.institution_id
            ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
        ) AS balance_rank
    FROM
        loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN
        credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN
        institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
)
SELECT
    institution_name,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    balance_rank
FROM
    RankedLoans
WHERE
    balance_rank = 1
ORDER BY
    institution_name ASC;

    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.contract_amount,
        ca.target_industry_code,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.target_industry_code ORDER BY ld.contract_amount DESC) as rank_in_industry
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
),
RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT
        lb.target_industry_code,
        lb.loan_id,
        lb.contract_amount,
        lb.rank_in_industry
    FROM LoanBalances lb
    WHERE lb.rank_in_industry <= 3
)

    isec.sector_name_zh,
    rl.loan_id,
    rl.contract_amount,
    rl.rank_in_industry
FROM RankedLoans rl

WITH payment_data AS (
    SELECT
        pe.payment_id,
        pe.amount,
        pe.currency_code,
        pe.status,
        pe.exception_flag,
        -- Determine the institution for the transaction
        COALESCE(
            (SELECT a1.institution_id FROM account a1 WHERE a1.account_id = pe.from_account_id),
            (SELECT a2.institution_id FROM account a2 WHERE a2.account_id = pe.to_account_id)
        ) AS trans_institution_id,
        -- Get payer party
        (SELECT ah.party_id FROM account_holder ah WHERE ah.account_id = pe.from_account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'Primary' LIMIT 1) AS payer_party_id,
        -- Get payee party
        (SELECT ah.party_id FROM account_holder ah WHERE ah.account_id = pe.to_account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'Primary' LIMIT 1) AS payee_party_id
    FROM payment_event pe
    WHERE pe.status = 'Success' -- Assuming only successful transactions count towards amounts
      AND pe.exception_flag = 0
),
institution_totals AS (
    SELECT
        trans_institution_id,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM payment_data
    GROUP BY trans_institution_id
),
related_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        pd.trans_institution_id,
        pd.amount
    FROM payment_data pd
    INNER JOIN party_relation pr
        ON pd.payer_party_id = pr.source_party_id
        AND pd.payee_party_id = pr.target_party_id
        AND pr.relation_type != 'Non-related' -- Assuming 'Non-related' is the value for non-related parties
    WHERE pd.trans_institution_id IS NOT NULL
      AND pd.payer_party_id IS NOT NULL
      AND pd.payee_party_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(rt.amount), 0) AS related_transaction_amount,
    it.total_amount AS total_transaction_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(rt.amount), 0) * 1.0 / it.total_amount AS ratio
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN institution_totals it ON i.institution_id = it.trans_institution_id
LEFT JOIN related_transactions rt ON i.institution_id = rt.trans_institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, it.total_amount
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

related_customers AS (

FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = (
    SELECT MAX(as_of_date)
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id
)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, p.party_id, i.institution_name, p.display_name, cs.net_capital

WITH industry_avg_rates AS (

        AVG(annual_interest_rate) as avg_rate

    GROUP BY target_industry_code
)
SELECT

    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ca.annual_interest_rate,
    iaa.avg_rate,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - iaa.avg_rate) * 1.0 / iaa.avg_rate * 100, 2) AS spread_percentage
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_avg_rates iaa ON ca.target_industry_code = iaa.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND iaa.avg_rate > 0
  AND (ca.annual_interest_rate - iaa.avg_rate) * 1.0 / iaa.avg_rate > 0.10

    WHERE cs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(cs2.as_of_date)
        FROM capital_snapshot cs2
        WHERE cs2.institution_id = cs.institution_id
    )
),
loan_to_institution AS (

        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        lb.principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance lb
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON lb.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
),
party_risk_exposure AS (

        SUM(li.principal_balance) as total_principal_balance
    FROM loan_to_institution li
    GROUP BY li.institution_id, li.borrower_party_id
),
party_capital_ratio AS (
    SELECT
        pre.institution_id,
        pre.borrower_party_id,
        pre.total_principal_balance,
        ic.net_capital,
        (pre.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / ic.net_capital) as ratio
    FROM party_risk_exposure pre
    JOIN institution_capital ic ON pre.institution_id = ic.institution_id
    WHERE ic.net_capital > 0
),
ranked_parties AS (
    SELECT
        pcr.institution_id,
        pcr.borrower_party_id,
        pcr.ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pcr.institution_id ORDER BY pcr.ratio DESC) as rn
    FROM party_capital_ratio pcr
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name as customer_name,
    rp.ratio
FROM ranked_parties rp
JOIN institution i ON rp.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON rp.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE rp.rn = 1
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

WITH RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.institution_id ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS quartile
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date)
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot
        WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
)
SELECT
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    quartile
FROM RankedLoans
ORDER BY quartile ASC, principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ld.institution_id,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    GROUP BY ld.institution_id
),
loan_details AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        inst.institution_name,
        ld.disbursed_amount AS principal_balance,
        lt.total_principal,
        ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / lt.total_principal * 100, 2) AS percentage
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN institution inst ON ld.institution_id = inst.institution_id
    JOIN loan_totals lt ON ld.institution_id = lt.institution_id
)
SELECT
    loan_id,
    institution_name,
    principal_balance,
    percentage
FROM loan_details
ORDER BY institution_name ASC, percentage DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    ld.status,
    COALESCE(SUM(ae.amount), 0) AS overdue_principal_total,
    COUNT(ae.resolution_id) AS overdue_count
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
LEFT JOIN
    asset_resolution_event ae
    ON ld.loan_id = ae.loan_id
    AND ae.event_type = 'OVERDUE'
WHERE
    ld.status = 'NORMAL'
GROUP BY
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.status
HAVING
    COUNT(ae.resolution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY
    overdue_count DESC,
    overdue_principal_total DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    loan_account_id,
    disbursed_on,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM
    loan_drawdown
GROUP BY
    loan_account_id,
    disbursed_on
HAVING
    COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY
    loan_count DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT
    ah.party_id
FROM
    account_holder ah
JOIN
    account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN
    term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ah.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY
    ah.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    sm.person_party_id
FROM
    staff_member sm
WHERE
    sm.employment_status = '在职'
    AND sm.person_party_id NOT IN (
        SELECT
            ah.party_id
        FROM
            account_holder ah
        WHERE
            ah.party_id = sm.person_party_id
    )
ORDER BY
    sm.person_party_id ASC;

SELECT
    a.account_id
FROM
    account a
WHERE
    a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
    AND a.account_id NOT IN (
        SELECT
            pe.from_account_id
        FROM
            payment_event pe
        WHERE
            pe.is_cash = 1
    )
ORDER BY
    a.account_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    gc.guaranteed_amount
FROM
    guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN
    security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE
    gc.effective_to IS NOT NULL
    AND gc.effective_to < DATE('now')
ORDER BY
    gc.guaranteed_amount DESC;

WITH loan_maturity AS (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        original_maturity_on,
        julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(original_maturity_on) AS remaining_days
    FROM loan_drawdown
    WHERE original_maturity_on IS NOT NULL
),
loan_buckets AS (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        CASE
            WHEN remaining_days < 0 THEN '已到期'
            WHEN remaining_days <= 90 THEN '临期'
            ELSE '常态'
        END AS bucket
    FROM loan_maturity
)
SELECT
    bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM loan_buckets
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY
    CASE bucket
        WHEN '常态' THEN 1
        WHEN '临期' THEN 2
        WHEN '已到期' THEN 3
    END;

SELECT
    c.collateral_id,
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS link_count
FROM
    collateral_asset c
JOIN
    collateral_link cl ON c.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
JOIN
    security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE
    cl.status = '有效'
    AND sa.status = '有效'
GROUP BY
    c.collateral_id
HAVING
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) > 1
ORDER BY
    link_count DESC;

SELECT
    collateral_type,
    AVG(collateral_value) AS avg_collateral_value,
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM
    collateral_asset
GROUP BY
    collateral_type
ORDER BY
    avg_collateral_value DESC;

WITH AccountLoanStats AS (
    SELECT
        ld.repayment_account_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.disbursed_on,
        ld.disbursed_amount,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.repayment_account_id) AS loan_count
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
),
RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT
        als.repayment_account_id,
        als.loan_id,
        als.disbursed_on,
        als.disbursed_amount,
        als.loan_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY als.repayment_account_id ORDER BY als.disbursed_on ASC) AS rn
    FROM AccountLoanStats als
    WHERE als.loan_count >= 3
)
SELECT
    rl.repayment_account_id,
    rl.loan_id,
    rl.disbursed_on,
    rl.disbursed_amount,
    rl.loan_count
FROM RankedLoans rl
WHERE rl.rn <= 2
ORDER BY rl.repayment_account_id ASC, rl.disbursed_on ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount AS excess_amount,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.contract_amount
HAVING
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count,
    SUM(a.ledger_balance - a.available_balance) AS total_difference
FROM
    account a
JOIN
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    a.ledger_balance > a.available_balance
    AND (a.ledger_balance - a.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    total_difference DESC;

SELECT
    t.account_id,
    t.opening_principal,
    t.maturity_on,
    t.annual_interest_rate
FROM
    term_deposit t
JOIN
    account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE
    t.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
    AND a.status = '正常'
ORDER BY
    t.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT
    card_id,
    card_type,
    issued_on
FROM
    payment_card
WHERE
    issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
    AND status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY
    issued_on ASC,
    card_id ASC;

WITH payment_stats AS (
    SELECT
        a.institution_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN pe.payment_type = 'entrusted' THEN pe.amount ELSE 0 END) AS entrusted_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN pe.payment_type = 'autonomous' THEN pe.amount ELSE 0 END) AS autonomous_amount
    FROM payment_event pe
    JOIN account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE pe.status = 'SUCCESS'
      AND pe.is_cash = 0
      AND pe.payment_type IN ('entrusted', 'autonomous')
    GROUP BY a.institution_id
),
total_stats AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        entrusted_amount,
        autonomous_amount,
        (entrusted_amount + autonomous_amount) AS total_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN (entrusted_amount + autonomous_amount) > 0
            THEN entrusted_amount * 1.0 / (entrusted_amount + autonomous_amount)
            ELSE 0
        END AS entrusted_ratio
    FROM payment_stats
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ts.entrusted_amount,
    ts.autonomous_amount,
    ts.entrusted_ratio
FROM total_stats ts
JOIN institution i ON ts.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ts.entrusted_ratio < 0.52
ORDER BY ts.entrusted_ratio ASC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS "授信合同编号",
    ld.loan_id AS "借据编号",
    ld.disbursed_amount AS "单笔放款金额",
    (SELECT SUM(ld2.disbursed_amount)
     FROM loan_drawdown ld2
     WHERE ld2.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
       AND ld2.status = 'ACTIVE'
    ) AS "合同内累计放款金额",
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(ld3.disbursed_amount)
                                        FROM loan_drawdown ld3
                                        WHERE ld3.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
                                          AND ld3.status = 'ACTIVE'
                                       ) * 100, 2) AS "单笔占比"
FROM
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE
    ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND (SELECT SUM(ld2.disbursed_amount)
         FROM loan_drawdown ld2
         WHERE ld2.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
           AND ld2.status = 'ACTIVE'
        ) > 0
    AND ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(ld3.disbursed_amount)
                                      FROM loan_drawdown ld3
                                      WHERE ld3.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
                                        AND ld3.status = 'ACTIVE'
                                     ) > 0.9
ORDER BY
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(wps.outstanding_balance) AS total_actual_raised,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_planned_raised,
    SUM(wps.outstanding_balance) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) AS completion_rate
FROM
    wealth_product wps
JOIN
    wealth_product wp ON wps.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN
    institution i ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING
    SUM(wps.outstanding_balance) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) > 1.2
ORDER BY
    completion_rate DESC;

WITH overdue_loans AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.agreement_id,
        ld.borrower_party_id
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
    WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
    GROUP BY ld.loan_id
),
borrower_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ld.borrower_party_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ol.loan_id IS NOT NULL THEN ld.loan_id END) AS overdue_loan_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS total_loan_count
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    LEFT JOIN overdue_loans ol ON ld.loan_id = ol.loan_id
    GROUP BY ld.borrower_party_id
    HAVING overdue_loan_count > 0 AND total_loan_count > overdue_loan_count
)
SELECT
    bs.borrower_party_id,
    p.display_name,
    bs.overdue_loan_count,
    bs.total_loan_count
FROM borrower_stats bs
JOIN party p ON bs.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY bs.overdue_loan_count DESC, bs.borrower_party_id ASC;

SELECT
    pi.instruction_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower.party_id
LEFT JOIN party payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id != ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.signed_on,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE
    ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS unsettled_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_principal_due
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE ld.loan_id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT loan_id
    FROM repayment_schedule
    WHERE status = '已结清'
)
GROUP BY ld.loan_id
ORDER BY total_principal_due DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(ld.current_maturity_on * 1.0, 2) AS end_remaining_principal,
    ROUND(ld.current_maturity_on * 1.0, 2) AS end_overdue_principal
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
WHERE
    ld.status = 'written_off'
    AND ld.current_maturity_on > 10000000
ORDER BY
    ld.current_maturity_on DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ld.loan_account_id,
    a.opened_on
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    account a ON ld.loan_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE
    ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY
    ld.disbursed_on ASC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.account_kind,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = '储蓄'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.security_type,
    ca.contract_amount,
    p.display_name
FROM
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE
    ca.security_type = '信用'
    AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY
    ca.contract_amount DESC,
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

WITH InstitutionAvgRates AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.product_family,
        AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.product_family
),
RelatedBorrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pr.source_party_id AS borrower_id
    FROM party_relation pr
    WHERE pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
),
LoanDetails AS (
    SELECT
        ca.agreement_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        ca.annual_interest_rate,
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.product_family,
        p.display_name AS borrower_name,
        p.party_id AS customer_code
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
      AND ca.borrower_party_id IN (SELECT borrower_id FROM RelatedBorrowers)
)
SELECT
    ld.borrower_name,
    ld.customer_code,
    ld.annual_interest_rate,
    iav.avg_rate,
    (ld.annual_interest_rate - iav.avg_rate) AS rate_spread
FROM LoanDetails ld
JOIN InstitutionAvgRates iav
    ON ld.institution_id = iav.institution_id
    AND ld.product_family = iav.product_family
ORDER BY rate_spread DESC;

SELECT
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    rtc.relation_name_zh
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN loan_drawdown ld1 ON ld1.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
)
JOIN loan_drawdown ld2 ON ld2.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
)
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
ORDER BY rtc.relation_name_zh, pr.relation_id;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT
        ra.agreement_id,
        ra.institution_id,
        ra.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM risk_exposure ra
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ra.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE ra.exposure_type = 'LOAN'
      AND lbs.as_of_date = (
          SELECT MAX(lbs2.as_of_date)
          FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2
          WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
      )
    GROUP BY ra.agreement_id, ra.institution_id, ra.borrower_party_id
),
group_members AS (
    SELECT
        egm.exposure_group_id,
        egm.party_id,
        lb.institution_id,
        lb.total_principal_balance
    FROM exposure_group_member egm
    JOIN loan_balances lb ON egm.party_id = lb.borrower_party_id
),
group_summary AS (
    SELECT
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        egm.institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
        SUM(egm.total_principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM group_members egm
    JOIN exposure_group eg ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, egm.institution_id
    HAVING member_count >= 2
),
capital AS (
    SELECT
        cs.institution_id,
        cs.net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot cs
    WHERE cs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(cs2.as_of_date)
        FROM capital_snapshot cs2
        WHERE cs2.institution_id = cs.institution_id
    )
)
SELECT
    gs.group_name,
    gs.member_count,
    gs.total_balance,
    c.net_capital,
    gs.total_balance * 1.0 / c.net_capital AS ratio
FROM group_summary gs
JOIN capital c ON gs.institution_id = c.institution_id
WHERE c.net_capital > 0
  AND (gs.total_balance * 1.0 / c.net_capital) > 0.1
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    payer.display_name AS payer_name,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(pe.amount) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account from_acc ON pe.from_account_id = from_acc.account_id
JOIN account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder payer_holder ON from_acc.account_id = payer_holder.account_id
JOIN party payer ON payer_holder.party_id = payer.party_id
JOIN account_holder payee_holder ON to_acc.account_id = payee_holder.account_id
JOIN party payee ON payee_holder.party_id = payee.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON (payer.party_id = pr.source_party_id AND payee.party_id = pr.target_party_id)
    OR (payee.party_id = pr.source_party_id AND payer.party_id = pr.target_party_id)
WHERE pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
GROUP BY payer.display_name, payee.display_name
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE
    wp.risk_level = 'R5'
    AND wp.status = '在售'
    AND phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
ORDER BY
    wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT
    t1.product_id,
    COUNT(t1.asset_id) AS asset_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot t1
WHERE t1.lookthrough_depth > 1
GROUP BY t1.product_id
ORDER BY asset_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS principal_balance,
    MAX(rc.days_overdue) AS max_days_overdue
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_amount > 90000000
  AND rc.days_overdue IS NOT NULL
  AND rc.days_overdue > 0
GROUP BY
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount
HAVING MAX(rc.days_overdue) >= 200
ORDER BY
    max_days_overdue DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT re.institution_id) AS involved_institution_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN risk_exposure re ON egm.party_id = re.obligor_party_id
    AND re.exposure_type = 'LOAN'
GROUP BY
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name
HAVING involved_institution_count >= 2
ORDER BY involved_institution_count DESC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS overdue_member_count,
    SUM(re.gross_exposure) AS overdue_principal_total
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN risk_exposure re ON egm.party_id = re.obligor_party_id
    AND eg.institution_id = re.institution_id
    AND re.exposure_type = 'LOAN'
WHERE re.gross_exposure > 0
GROUP BY
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name
ORDER BY
    overdue_principal_total DESC;

WITH borrower_loans AS (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
guarantor_guarantees AS (
    SELECT
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guarantee_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        p.party_id,
        p.display_name,
        COALESCE(gl.total_loan_amount, 0) AS total_loan_amount,
        COALESCE(gg.total_guarantee_amount, 0) AS total_guarantee_amount
    FROM party p
    INNER JOIN borrower_loans gl ON p.party_id = gl.borrower_party_id
    INNER JOIN guarantor_guarantees gg ON p.party_id = gg.guarantor_party_id
)
SELECT
    display_name,
    party_id,

    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 现金交易笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM
    payment_card pc
JOIN
    payment_event pe ON pc.card_id = pe.channel -- 假设channel字段存储card_id或类似标识，但根据schema，payment_event有from_account_id/to_account_id，没有直接card_id。
                     -- 重新审视schema: payment_event 没有 card_id 字段。
                     -- 但是 payment_card 有 settlement_account_id。
                     -- 通常现金交易（套现）可能通过特定渠道或账户发生。
                     -- 题目提到“贷记卡持卡人发生的现金交易”，且 payment_event 中有 is_cash 字段。
                     -- 但是 payment_event 表本身没有直接关联到 payment_card 的字段。
                     -- 让我们看 payment_event 的字段: payment_id, from_account_id, to_account_id, ..., channel, is_cash, ..., operator_id, origin_org_unit_id, balance_after, status, exception_flag.
                     -- payment_card 的字段: card_id, settlement_account_id, holder_party_id, ..., status, exception_flag.
                     -- 如果交易是通过信用卡进行的，通常会有特定的 channel 或者通过 settlement_account_id 关联。
                     -- 然而，payment_event 中没有 card_id。
                     -- 另一种可能性：题目隐含了通过 account 关联。贷记卡关联到 settlement_account_id。
                     -- 如果交易是从该 settlement_account_id 发起的（from_account_id），或者与该账户相关。
                     -- 但更常见的情况是，如果是信用卡取现或套现，可能是在特定的账户上操作。
                     -- 让我们假设“现金交易”指的是 payment_event 中 is_cash = 1 的记录。
                     -- 如何将这些交易与持卡人关联？
                     -- 路径1: payment_event -> account (from_account_id or to_account_id) -> payment_card (settlement_account_id) -> party (holder_party_id).
                     -- 路径2: 也许 channel 字段包含了卡号信息？不太可能，通常是渠道名称如 'CREDIT_CARD', 'ATM' 等。
                     -- 鉴于 schema 中 payment_event 没有 card_id，最合理的关联是通过账户。
                     -- 贷记卡绑定一个结算账户 (settlement_account_id)。
                     -- 如果持卡人使用该卡进行现金交易，这笔交易很可能发生在该结算账户上，或者通过该卡发起。
                     -- 由于 payment_event 只有 from_account_id 和 to_account_id，我们可以检查交易是否涉及该结算账户。
                     -- 通常，套现/取现是从信用卡账户转出资金到借记卡或现金。
                     -- 让我们尝试关联：payment_event 的 from_account_id 或 to_account_id 等于 payment_card 的 settlement_account_id。
                     -- 或者，更简单地，如果题目暗示所有通过该卡发生的交易都可以通过某种方式追踪，但在当前 schema 下，最直接的物理关联是账户。
                     -- 让我们假设：如果 payment_event 的 from_account_id 或 to_account_id 匹配 payment_card 的 settlement_account_id，则视为该卡交易。
                     -- 但这样可能会漏掉一些情况，或者包含非该卡的交易（如果账户共用，但贷记卡通常独占结算账户）。
                     -- 让我们采用：payment_event 的 from_account_id 或 to_account_id 在 payment_card 的 settlement_account_id 中。
                     
                     -- 修正思路：题目问的是“贷记卡持卡人发生的现金交易”。
                     -- 1. 找到所有贷记卡 (payment_card).
                     -- 2. 找到这些卡对应的结算账户 (settlement_account_id).
                     -- 3. 找到所有涉及这些账户的现金交易 (payment_event where is_cash = 1).
                     -- 4. 统计。
                     
                     -- 注意：payment_event 的 channel 字段可能是 'CREDIT_CARD' 或其他，但 is_cash 是明确的布尔值。
                     
                     -- 关联逻辑：
                     -- payment_card pc
                     -- JOIN account acc ON pc.settlement_account_id = acc.account_id
                     -- JOIN payment_event pe ON (pe.from_account_id = acc.account_id OR pe.to_account_id = acc.account_id)
                     
                     -- 但是，payment_event 中 is_cash = 1 表示现金交易。
                     
                     -- 让我们构建查询。
FROM
    payment_card pc
JOIN
    account acc ON pc.settlement_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN
    payment_event pe ON (pe.from_account_id = acc.account_id OR pe.to_account_id = acc.account_id)
WHERE
    pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY
    pc.holder_party_id
HAVING
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) > 5
ORDER BY
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) DESC,
    SUM(pe.amount) DESC;

SELECT
    holder_party_id,
    COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM
    payment_card
GROUP BY
    holder_party_id
HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY
    card_count DESC,
    holder_party_id ASC;

SELECT
    pc.card_type,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(pe.payment_id), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM
    payment_event pe
JOIN
    payment_card pc ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
WHERE
    pc.card_type IN ('贷记卡', '借记卡')
    AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY
    pc.card_type
ORDER BY
    avg_amount DESC,
    pc.card_type ASC;

SELECT
    channel,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
FROM
    payment_event
WHERE
    status = 'SETTLED'
    AND is_cash = 0
GROUP BY
    channel
HAVING
    AVG(amount) > 11780000
ORDER BY
    avg_amount DESC,
    channel ASC;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    td.maturity_on,
    a.status
FROM
    account a
JOIN
    term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE
    td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
    AND td.maturity_on <= DATE('now')
    AND a.status = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY
    td.maturity_on DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH CollateralValuations AS (
    SELECT
        ca.collateral_id,
        ca.asset_label,
        cl.pledged_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.collateral_id ORDER BY cl.pledged_amount DESC) as rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.collateral_id) as eval_count
    FROM collateral_asset ca
    JOIN collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
    WHERE cl.pledged_amount IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    collateral_id,
    asset_label,
    pledged_amount
FROM CollateralValuations
WHERE rn = 1 AND eval_count >= 2
ORDER BY pledged_amount DESC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS citation_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS distinct_security_count
FROM
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN
    collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE
    cl.status = 'VALID'
GROUP BY
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label
HAVING
    citation_count >= 2
ORDER BY
    citation_count DESC,
    ca.collateral_id ASC;

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ld.agreement_id,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE' OR ld.status = 'NORMAL'
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id
),
guarantor_details AS (
    SELECT
        gc.commitment_id,
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        gc.guaranteed_amount,
        gc.security_id,
        gc.effective_from,
        gc.effective_to,
        gc.status
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND (gc.effective_to IS NULL OR gc.effective_to >= DATE('now'))
),
security_to_agreement AS (
    SELECT
        so.security_id,
        so.agreement_id
    FROM secured_obligation so
    WHERE so.agreement_id IS NOT NULL
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        gd.guarantor_party_id,
        gd.guaranteed_amount,
        stoa.agreement_id,
        lt.total_disbursed_amount
    FROM guarantor_details gd
    JOIN security_to_agreement stoa ON gd.security_id = stoa.security_id
    JOIN loan_totals lt ON stoa.agreement_id = lt.agreement_id
    WHERE gd.guaranteed_amount > lt.total_disbursed_amount
)
SELECT
    jd.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name,
    jd.agreement_id,
    ROUND(jd.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS guaranteed_amount,
    ROUND(jd.total_disbursed_amount, 2) AS total_disbursed_amount
FROM joined_data jd
JOIN party p ON jd.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY jd.guaranteed_amount DESC, jd.guarantor_party_id ASC, jd.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.borrower_party_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(sa.secured_amount), 0) AS total_secured_amount,
    ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(sa.secured_amount), 0) AS coverage_gap
FROM credit_agreement ca
LEFT JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE ca.status = 'Effective'
  AND sa.status = 'Effective'
GROUP BY
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.borrower_party_id,
    ca.contract_amount
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(sa.secured_amount), 0) < ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
    INNER JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
    INNER JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
    INNER JOIN institution i ON ld.agreement_id IN (
        SELECT ca.agreement_id
        FROM credit_agreement ca
        WHERE ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    )
    INNER JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE
    cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
    AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY
    loan_count DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ca.borrower_party_id AS debtor_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS loan_balance,
    ca.contract_amount AS credit_limit,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS balance_multiple
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE
    ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount >= 4.0
ORDER BY
    balance_multiple DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    rc.grade_code,
    COUNT(*) AS over_provision_count,
    SUM(rpe.amount) AS over_provision_amount
FROM
    risk_classification rc
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN
    institution i ON ld.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN
    asset_resolution_event rpe ON ld.loan_id = rpe.loan_id
WHERE
    rpe.event_type = 'PROVISION_OVER_PROVISION'
    AND rpe.status = 'CONFIRMED'
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name,
    rc.grade_code
ORDER BY
    over_provision_amount DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC,
    rc.grade_code ASC;

WITH InternalMax AS (
    SELECT
        collateral_id,
        MAX(valuation_method) as internal_val
    FROM collateral_asset
    WHERE valuation_method = 'INTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
),
ExternalMax AS (
    SELECT
        collateral_id,
        MAX(valuation_method) as external_val
    FROM collateral_asset
    WHERE valuation_method = 'EXTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
)
SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(im.internal_val, 2) as internal_max_value,
    ROUND(em.external_val, 2) as external_max_value,
    ROUND(im.internal_val - em.external_val, 2) as difference
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN InternalMax im ON ca.collateral_id = im.collateral_id
JOIN ExternalMax em ON ca.collateral_id = em.collateral_id
WHERE im.internal_val > em.external_val
ORDER BY (im.internal_val - em.external_val) DESC;

WITH borrower_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_borrowed_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = 'Active'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
guarantor_totals AS (
    SELECT
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'Active'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
mutual_guarantors AS (
    SELECT
        bt.borrower_party_id,
        bt.total_borrowed_amount,
        gt.total_guaranteed_amount
    FROM borrower_totals bt
    INNER JOIN guarantor_totals gt ON bt.borrower_party_id = gt.guarantor_party_id
    WHERE gt.total_guaranteed_amount > bt.total_borrowed_amount
)
SELECT
    mg.borrower_party_id AS guarantor_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    mg.total_borrowed_amount,
    mg.total_guaranteed_amount
FROM mutual_guarantors mg
JOIN party p ON mg.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY mg.total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM
    security_agreement sa
JOIN
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE
    gc.status = 'VALID'
GROUP BY
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount
HAVING
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM
    party p
JOIN
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE
    pp.is_public_official = 1
    AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
GROUP BY
    p.customer_segment
ORDER BY
    customer_count DESC,
    p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    sc.name_zh AS exposure_group_type_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN status_catalog sc ON eg.group_type = sc.status_code AND sc.entity = 'exposure_group_type'
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    eg.group_type,
    sc.name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY member_count DESC;

SELECT
    m.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM
    exposure_group_member m
JOIN
    party p ON m.party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY
    m.party_id,
    p.display_name
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY
    group_count DESC,
    m.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS relation_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS loan_agreement_count
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id IN (pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id)
JOIN institution i ON 1=1
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY relation_count DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type = 'shadow_shareholder'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY group_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

WITH party_loan_counts AS (
    SELECT
        party_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT agreement_id) AS loan_count
    FROM credit_agreement
    GROUP BY party_id
),
related_parties_with_loans AS (
    SELECT
        pr.relation_id,
        pr.source_party_id,
        pr.target_party_id,
        COALESCE(slc.loan_count, 0) AS source_loan_count,
        COALESCE(tlc.loan_count, 0) AS target_loan_count
    FROM party_relation pr
    JOIN party_loan_counts slc ON pr.source_party_id = slc.party_id
    JOIN party_loan_counts tlc ON pr.target_party_id = tlc.party_id
    WHERE slc.loan_count > 0 AND tlc.loan_count > 0
)
SELECT
    relation_id,
    source_party_id,
    target_party_id,
    source_loan_count,
    target_loan_count
FROM related_parties_with_loans
ORDER BY (source_loan_count + target_loan_count) DESC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ca.collateral_type
FROM
    collateral_asset ca
WHERE
    ca.status = '有效'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM collateral_link cl
        WHERE cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
          AND cl.status = '有效'
    )
ORDER BY
    ca.collateral_id ASC;

WITH guarantor_liability AS (
    SELECT
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.effective_to IS NULL
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
borrower_exposure AS (
    SELECT
        ld.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(lbs2.as_of_date)
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
    GROUP BY ld.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT
    p.party_id AS guarantor_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ROUND(gl.total_guaranteed_amount, 2) AS total_guarantee_liability,
    ROUND(COALESCE(be.total_loan_balance, 0), 2) AS own_loan_exposure,
    ROUND(gl.total_guaranteed_amount - COALESCE(be.total_loan_balance, 0), 2) AS excess_guarantee_amount
FROM party p
JOIN guarantor_liability gl ON p.party_id = gl.guarantor_party_id
LEFT JOIN borrower_exposure be ON p.party_id = be.borrower_party_id
WHERE gl.total_guaranteed_amount > COALESCE(be.total_loan_balance, 0)
ORDER BY excess_guarantee_amount DESC;

SELECT
    guarantor_commitment.guarantor_party_id,
    party.display_name,
    guarantor_commitment.guaranteed_amount,
    guarantor_commitment.status
FROM
    guarantor_commitment
JOIN
    party ON guarantor_commitment.guarantor_party_id = party.party_id
JOIN
    security_agreement ON guarantor_commitment.security_id = security_agreement.security_id
JOIN
    secured_obligation ON security_agreement.security_id = secured_obligation.security_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ON secured_obligation.agreement_id = credit_agreement.agreement_id
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ON credit_agreement.agreement_id = loan_drawdown.agreement_id
WHERE
    loan_drawdown.status = 'OVERDUE'
    AND loan_drawdown.borrower_party_id = guarantor_commitment.guarantor_party_id
ORDER BY
    guarantor_commitment.guaranteed_amount DESC,
    guarantor_commitment.guarantor_party_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS overdue_principal_total
FROM
    wealth_product wp
    JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
    JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ma.asset_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
WHERE
    rc.grade_code IN ('N', 'D', 'L') -- Assuming N/D/L represent overdue/non-performing grades, adjust based on actual data if needed. Commonly 'N' (Normal) is good, 'S' (Special Mention), 'M' (Substandard), 'D' (Doubtful), 'L' (Loss). Overdue usually maps to Substandard, Doubtful, Loss. Let's assume a generic 'is_overdue' flag or specific codes. Since no explicit 'overdue' flag exists on loan_drawdown, we rely on risk_classification.
    AND rc.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(rc2.as_of_date)
        FROM risk_classification rc2
        WHERE rc2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
    AND ma.obligor_party_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT ld2.obligor_party_id
        FROM loan_drawdown ld2
        JOIN risk_classification rc3 ON ld2.loan_id = rc3.loan_id
        WHERE rc3.grade_code IN ('M', 'D', 'L') -- Substandard, Doubtful, Loss
        AND rc3.as_of_date = (
            SELECT MAX(rc4.as_of_date)
            FROM risk_classification rc4
            WHERE rc4.loan_id = ld2.loan_id
        )
    )
GROUP BY
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY
    wp.product_name ASC,
    overdue_principal_total DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_type,
    COUNT(sa.security_id) AS contract_count,
    ROUND(SUM(sa.secured_amount), 2) AS total_secured_amount
FROM
    security_agreement sa
JOIN
    secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE
    ca.status = 'EFFECTIVE'
GROUP BY
    sa.security_type
ORDER BY
    total_secured_amount DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON ca.agreement_id = sa.security_id
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id AND cl.status = 'Active'
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id AND gc.status = 'Active'
WHERE ca.status = 'Active'
  AND sa.status = 'Active'
GROUP BY
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name,
    ca.contract_amount
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) > 0
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) > 0
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM
    exposure_group_member egm
JOIN
    exposure_group eg ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN
    institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN
    risk_exposure re ON egm.party_id = re.obligor_party_id AND re.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON re.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) AS inverted_amount_sum,
    COUNT(phs.holding_id) AS inverted_holding_count
FROM
    product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN
    wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
WHERE
    phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name
HAVING
    SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY
    inverted_amount_sum DESC,
    wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(ld.overdue_principal), 0) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ma.obligor_party_id = ld.borrower_party_id
    AND ld.status IN ('OVERDUE', 'DEFAULT', 'NON_PERFORMING') -- Assuming these statuses indicate overdue/non-performing
    AND ld.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id -- "本行" refers to the issuer institution of the wealth product
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
GROUP BY
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    phs.holding_id
ORDER BY
    phs.lookthrough_depth DESC,
    phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_priority_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_pledge_ratio_count
FROM
    collateral_link cl
WHERE
    cl.lien_priority = 1
    AND cl.status = 'Effective'
GROUP BY
    cl.collateral_id
HAVING
    COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY
    high_pledge_ratio_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    fs.total_assets,
    fs.total_liabilities,
    fs.net_assets,
    fs.annual_revenue
FROM
    institution i
JOIN
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY
    fs.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.total_liabilities * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 4) AS asset_liability_ratio
FROM
    institution i
JOIN
    financial_snapshot fs ON i.institution_id = fs.party_id
WHERE
    fs.total_assets > 0
ORDER BY
    asset_liability_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(c.net_capital * 1.0 / c.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS core_tier1_to_rwa_ratio
FROM
    institution i
JOIN
    capital_snapshot c ON i.institution_id = c.institution_id
WHERE
    c.risk_weighted_assets IS NOT NULL
    AND c.risk_weighted_assets != 0
    AND c.net_capital IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    core_tier1_to_rwa_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(
        (cs.net_capital * 1.0) / fs.total_assets,
        6
    ) AS net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio
FROM
    institution i
JOIN
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN
    financial_snapshot fs ON i.institution_id = fs.party_id
WHERE
    fs.party_id LIKE 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY
    net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    fs.annual_revenue,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / total_revenue.total_annual_revenue, 2) AS revenue_ratio
FROM
    institution i
JOIN
    financial_snapshot fs ON i.institution_id = fs.party_id
JOIN
    (
        SELECT
            SUM(annual_revenue) AS total_annual_revenue
        FROM
            financial_snapshot
        WHERE
            party_id LIKE 'PTY-%'
    ) total_revenue
WHERE
    fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / total_revenue.total_annual_revenue > 0.15
ORDER BY
    revenue_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    ma.originator_institution_id,
    COUNT(*) AS inconsistent_count
FROM
    managed_asset ma
WHERE
    ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL
    AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL
    AND ma.internal_rating != ma.external_rating
GROUP BY
    ma.originator_institution_id
ORDER BY
    inconsistent_count DESC;

SELECT
    m.asset_category_primary,
    ROUND(SUM(h.converted_amount), 2) AS total_converted_amount
FROM product_holding_snapshot h
JOIN managed_asset m ON h.asset_id = m.asset_id
GROUP BY m.asset_category_primary
ORDER BY total_converted_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS count,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM
    institution i
JOIN
    account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN
    term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    total_principal DESC;

SELECT
    t1.institution_id,
    COUNT(t2.account_id) AS count
FROM institution t1
JOIN account t2 ON t1.institution_id = t2.institution_id
JOIN term_deposit t3 ON t2.account_id = t3.account_id
WHERE t3.annual_interest_rate > 3.0
GROUP BY t1.institution_id
ORDER BY count DESC;

SELECT
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE sm.employment_type = '固定雇佣'
GROUP BY so.authority_level
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY operator_count DESC, so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(t.account_id) AS count
FROM term_deposit t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE t.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND t.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30'
  AND t.maturity_on <= date('2026-06-30', '+30 days')
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) AS under_provision_total,
    fs.net_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) * 1.0 / fs.net_assets * 100, 2) AS under_provision_ratio_pct
FROM
    institution i
JOIN
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
JOIN
    provision_snapshot p ON p.loan_id IN (
        SELECT ld.loan_id
        FROM loan_drawdown ld
        JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
        WHERE ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
    )
    AND p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount
WHERE
    fs.net_assets > 0
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    fs.net_assets
HAVING
    SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) > 0
ORDER BY
    under_provision_ratio_pct DESC,
    i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT
    rc.grade_code,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
WHERE
    rc.classification_basis = '人工认定'
    AND rc.grade_code IN ('不良', 'NPL', 'Substandard', 'Doubtful', 'Loss')
GROUP BY
    rc.grade_code
HAVING
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 60
    AND COUNT(ld.loan_id) <= 105
ORDER BY
    loan_count DESC,
    rc.grade_code ASC;

WITH bad_loans AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.agreement_id,
        ld.disbursed_amount,
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'OVERDUE'
      AND ld.exception_flag = 0
),
loan_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        COUNT(loan_id) AS bad_loan_count,
        SUM(disbursed_amount) AS total_bad_loan_principal
    FROM bad_loans
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
institution_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        annual_revenue
    FROM financial_snapshot
    WHERE party_id = 'PTY-' || institution_id
      AND source_kind = 'REGULATORY'
      AND as_of_date = (
          SELECT MAX(fs2.as_of_date)
          FROM financial_snapshot fs2
          WHERE fs2.party_id = 'PTY-' || financial_snapshot.institution_id
            AND fs2.source_kind = 'REGULATORY'
      )
),
combined_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        lm.institution_id,
        lm.bad_loan_count,
        lm.total_bad_loan_principal,
        ir.annual_revenue,
        CASE
            WHEN ir.annual_revenue > 0 THEN lm.total_bad_loan_principal * 1.0 / ir.annual_revenue
            ELSE NULL
        END AS principal_to_revenue_ratio
    FROM loan_metrics lm
    LEFT JOIN institution_revenue ir ON lm.institution_id = ir.institution_id
)
SELECT
    institution_id,
    bad_loan_count,
    total_bad_loan_principal
FROM combined_metrics
WHERE principal_to_revenue_ratio > 0.5
ORDER BY total_bad_loan_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 0) AS total_principal_balance,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(cs.risk_weighted_assets, 0), 2) AS loan_to_rwa_percentage
FROM
    institution i
LEFT JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON i.institution_id = (
        SELECT ca.institution_id 
        FROM credit_agreement ca 
        WHERE ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    )
LEFT JOIN
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE
    ld.closed_on IS NULL
    AND cs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(cs2.as_of_date)
        FROM capital_snapshot cs2
        WHERE cs2.institution_id = i.institution_id
    )
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY
    loan_to_rwa_percentage DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    pi.payment_mode,
    COUNT(pi.instruction_id) AS instruction_count
FROM
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE
    pi.status = 'PENDING'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    pi.payment_mode
HAVING
    COUNT(pi.instruction_id) > 45
ORDER BY
    instruction_count DESC,
    pi.payment_mode ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(r.record_id) AS abnormal_record_count,
    SUM(r.amount_value) AS abnormal_amount,
    cs.net_capital,
    fs.total_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(r.amount_value) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital * 100, 4) AS ratio_to_net_capital
FROM
    institution i
JOIN
    prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 r ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
JOIN
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN
    financial_snapshot fs ON 'PTY-' || i.institution_id = fs.party_id
WHERE
    r.exception_flag = 1
    AND cs.net_capital > 0
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    cs.net_capital,
    fs.total_assets
HAVING
    COUNT(r.record_id) >= 8
ORDER BY
    ratio_to_net_capital DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rse.status_code != 'COMPLETED' THEN rse.record_id END) AS overdue_record_count,
    ROUND(AVG(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS avg_loan_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount THEN ps.loan_id END) AS insufficient_provision_loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount THEN (ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) ELSE 0 END), 2) AS provision_gap_amount
FROM institution i
JOIN regulatory_submission_event_v3 rse ON i.institution_id = rse.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON i.institution_id = ld.institution_id
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE rse.event_code LIKE '%OVERDUE%'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rse.status_code != 'COMPLETED' THEN rse.record_id END) >= 25
ORDER BY provision_gap_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS credit_facility_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 THEN gcr.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS abnormal_amount_sum,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 THEN gcr.ratio_value END), 4) AS avg_abnormal_ratio
FROM
    institution i
JOIN
    credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
JOIN
    governance_control_record_v3 gcr ON i.institution_id = gcr.institution_id
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING
    SUM(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
ORDER BY
    abnormal_amount_sum DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS target_party_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS relation_type_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_related_party_count
FROM
    party p
JOIN
    party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE
    pr.source_kind = '客户'
    AND p.party_id IN (
        SELECT source_party_id
        FROM party_relation
        WHERE source_kind = '客户'
    )
GROUP BY
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY
    target_party_count DESC,
    relation_type_count DESC,
    customer_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COALESCE(card_stats.valid_card_count, 0) AS valid_card_count,
    COALESCE(card_stats.holder_count, 0) AS holder_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(risk_stats.exception_amount, 0), 2) AS exception_amount,
    risk_stats.valid_record_count
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        a.institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS holder_count
    FROM payment_card pc
    JOIN account a ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE pc.status = '有效'
    GROUP BY a.institution_id
) card_stats ON i.institution_id = card_stats.institution_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = '有效' THEN 1 END) AS valid_record_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = '有效' AND exception_flag = 1 THEN amount_value ELSE 0 END) AS exception_amount
    FROM operational_risk_event_v3
    GROUP BY institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN status = '有效' THEN 1 END) >= 43
) risk_stats ON i.institution_id = risk_stats.institution_id
WHERE risk_stats.valid_record_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.product_id) AS on_sale_product_count,
    SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) AS total_actual_raise_amount,
    COUNT(v3.record_id) AS abnormal_record_count,
    ROUND(AVG(v3.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio_value
FROM
    institution i
JOIN
    wealth_product wp ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
JOIN
    prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 v3 ON i.institution_id = v3.institution_id
WHERE
    wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
    AND v3.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING
    COUNT(v3.record_id) >= 2
ORDER BY
    total_actual_raise_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS asset_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ma.issued_amount), 2) AS total_issued_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ma.status = 'Effective' THEN ma.asset_id END) AS effective_custody_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ma.exception_flag = 1 THEN ma.issued_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount_total
FROM
    institution i
JOIN
    managed_asset ma ON i.institution_id = ma.originator_institution_id
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ma.exception_flag = 1 THEN ma.asset_id END) >= 2
ORDER BY
    total_issued_amount DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;
